viewing_check: Check the case back stock number (6645-66-031-3804) and any broad arrow, RAAF or date marks; check the movement caliber (open the back if allowed) and whether the pushers start, stop and reset; check dial scratches under magnification and whether the glass is intact; look for the seconds hand running.
